$comment: The products the admin kit knows about: the plugins that carry it, the Freemius bundle that sells them together, and the fixed addresses every copy uses. Rendered unchanged into every host (wp/bin/build-admin-kit.php), read by Products in PHP and handed to the React shell in its boot data.
A new plugin that carries the kit is a row here plus an `admin_kit` entry in wp/plugins.json. A product the kit only PROMOTES (Zinn SEO, later) is a row in promotions.json instead, and needs no code.

The bundle ids are Freemius's public identifiers (docs/843 D8, bundle 40216, read back by the L03 store configuration 2026-09-27). The public key is public by design; the secret key lives in Vault (secret/vendors/freemius/bundle) and never appears in a plugin. build-admin-kit.php writes these three values into each host's SDK init, so changing them here is the whole change.
`main_files` lists every basename the product is installed under (free and premium), so 'is the other plugin active?' is answered for both editions.
`docs_root` is where a help link goes when a screen has no guide of its own. It must be a page that answers 200 today (CLAUDE.md 2.41): scripts/wp-admin-kit-check.py --live asserts it.
